session_read: DEEP REVIEW (pre-market prices, 09:30Z): GATE ESCALATING. VIX +13.8%, NQ -1.84%, KOSPI -3.26%; every AI-capex cluster is down 5-6% pre-market. Catalyst read: a macro repricing (57% FOMC hike odds after Warsh, Hormuz oil spike, AI-slowdown sentiment), not a name-level fundamental break; thesis is unchanged on all 28 names. Scout regime is risk_off into the 09-16 FOMC. Ladders: TSM leads and AMAT lags in semis (China export-control hit); LITE leads and APH lags in optics; MSFT leads and NBIS lags in hyperscalers. New proposals: BUY TSM $1,462, BUY APH $1,088, SELL MU / BUY KLAC, SELL SMCI. The ASML/TER/AMAT catalyst trims stay open. Cash is 23.5% vs the 5-15% band. With a hawkish Fed 48 hours out, buy timing matters more than buy size.
